ui_bugs.issue: RedeemDialog is mounted TWICE — once in App.js line 224 (event-driven) and once in ExcelHeader.jsx line 97 (prop-driven, but the component ignores props and only listens to 'open-redeem' custom event). Both instances open simultaneously when the Hub tile fires the event → two overlapping modals in the DOM. Locators like `[data-testid="redeem-code-input"]` resolve to 2 elements; strict-mode Playwright and possibly real users interacting via keyboard-shortcuts / paste-to-first-focused could target the phantom (offscreen) instance instead of the visible one. HIGHLY likely the RCA of the customer tester's 'codes not working' report — depending on which instance receives the paste event, the state on the visible dialog stays empty and the Redeem button stays disabled. Fix: remove the mount in ExcelHeader.jsx (or convert RedeemDialog to accept controlled `open`/`onClose` props instead of the global event, then remove the App.js mount).

action_items: CRITICAL: RedeemDialog is duplicate-mounted (App.js + ExcelHeader.jsx). Remove one mount — recommend deleting the <RedeemDialog open=... /> in ExcelHeader.jsx since the component ignores its props and only reacts to the global 'open-redeem' event. This is almost certainly what the customer tester was hitting. When I ran Playwright with a normal `.fill` on `[data-testid=redeem-code-input]`, only the phantom (bottom-z) instance received the value; the visible dialog stayed empty with a disabled Redeem button — exactly matching the user's complaint. My tests only passed after I set the value on ALL matching inputs via evaluate().
Also flag to user: if fix is deployed only in preview, ask their tester to hard-refresh / redeploy — but the duplicate-mount above is the real bug and needs to ship.

rca of the issue: Customer tester's 'codes not working' report likely caused by duplicate mount of <RedeemDialog /> — App.js mounts one globally that listens to the 'open-redeem' custom event, AND ExcelHeader.jsx mounts a second one that ALSO listens to the same event. When the Hub 'Have an Invite Code?' tile dispatches open-redeem, BOTH dialogs open. Depending on paint order and event target, the tester's keystrokes/paste may land on the phantom dialog instead of the visible one. Backend + input normalization fixes are correct — the frontend duplicate-mount is the last mile. Reproduction: /hub as any user → click hub-redeem-tile → inspect DOM → `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=redeem-dialog]').length === 2`. Mitigation: delete the <RedeemDialog open={redeemOpen} onClose={...} /> line in /app/frontend/src/components/ExcelHeader.jsx (line 97) and its import (line 7). The App.js global instance is sufficient since Hub uses event dispatch.
